university.name: The Superior University, Lahore
university.campuses_text: Main Campus; City Campus; Gold Campus; Faisalabad Campus; Sargodha Campus; Rahim Yar Khan Campus; Layyah Campus; RAK Campus (UAE); Okara Campus
university.hero_subtitle: Admissions Open Fall 2026 | Discover your 3C Advantages
university.about_text:
Those who choose Superior University don’t just join an institution; they learn, question, innovate, teach, and grow. Becoming capable, shaping a legacy defined by better ideas, work, and future.

Our journey began in 2000 with the founding of Superior College Lahore. In 2003, the institution received its NOC from the Government of Punjab, followed by the establishment of a purpose-built campus at 17 KM Raiwind Road, Lahore in 2004. In 2008, Superior College Lahore was granted a Charter as a Degree Awarding Institute (DAI). HEC lists the university as established since 16 June 2004.

Today, Superior University is recognised nationally and internationally for its commitment to excellence in education and impact. While milestones and recognition reflect progress, our focus remains clear: preparing capable graduates who are ready to contribute meaningfully, locally and globally.
university.mission: We are committed to transform the lives of our students, faculty, staff and alumni by providing an excellent learning and research environment which ensures success in their personal, professional and spiritual lives. We believe in developing ‘Superheroes’ who can create social and economic impact by exhibiting character mastery and entrepreneurial mindset to build a sustainable community.
university.vision: To become a leading Pakistani university driving excellence in learning, innovation, and research.
university.address: 17 KM, Main Raiwind Road, Lahore, Punjab
university.ranking_label: 1st overall ranked private-sector university in Pakistan; among 200 world’s most innovative universities in WURI 2026; THE Quality of Education 101–200

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – Main Campus
campuses.address: 17 KM, Main Raiwind Road, Lahore, Punjab
campuses.description: Superior University’s Main Campus is committed to delivering quality education while fostering future employability and economic growth through innovative frameworks such as the 3U1M framework. The campus provides students with a solid theoretical foundation while offering practical exposure to market dynamics. Facilities include aviation labs, IT labs, computer labs, anatomy labs, and libraries.
campuses.why_choose: 3U1M experiential learning; purpose-built Raiwind Road campus; aviation, IT, computer and anatomy labs.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – City Campus
campuses.address: 22-A, Block E-2, Gulberg 3, Opposite Qaddafi Stadium, Lahore, Punjab
campuses.description: Located in the heart of Lahore, Superior University’s City Campus offers degree programs in Economics and Commerce, Arts and Humanities, Social Sciences, and Associate Degree Programs (ADPs).
campuses.why_choose: Central Gulberg location opposite Qaddafi Stadium; ADP and social sciences focus.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – Gold Campus
campuses.address: 6 KM, Main Raiwind Road, Lahore, Punjab
campuses.description: Gold Campus houses Computer Science and Information Technology programs, with laboratories and HEC-aligned curriculum.
campuses.why_choose: Dedicated CS/IT campus with labs and HEC-approved curriculum.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – Faisalabad Campus
campuses.address: Near Khanowana Bypass, 13 KM, Satiana Road, Faisalabad, Punjab
campuses.description: Offers programs in Business Administration, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Computer Science, Information Technology, Architecture, and Design. Facilities include library, auditorium, classrooms, laboratories, mosque, cafeteria, dispensary, playgrounds, and separate hostels for male and female students.
campuses.why_choose: Purpose-built Faisalabad campus with hostels, mosque, labs, and playgrounds.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – Sargodha Campus
campuses.description: An extension of Superior University Lahore offering market-oriented programs, ETTP, and 3U1M. Faculty pages highlight Business and Management Sciences and Allied Health Sciences.
campuses.why_choose: 3U1M and ETTP pathways in Sargodha with stated graduate employability focus.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – Rahim Yar Khan Campus
campuses.address: East Bank Sadiq Canal, Dari Sangi, Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab
campuses.description: Offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs with library, computer lab, teaching labs, and air-conditioned classrooms with AV aids. 3U1M internships are part of the model.
campuses.why_choose: Regional access in southern Punjab with labs and 3U1M industry exposure.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – Layyah Campus
campuses.address: Canal Road Karor Near Sugar Mill, Layyah
campuses.description: Established to expand access in Southern Punjab. Classrooms, computer and teaching labs, and a library. Undergraduate and postgraduate programs with 3U1M.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – RAK Campus
campuses.address: 5th Floor, Tower 2, RAKEZ Service Centre, Amenity Centre, Al Jazeera Al Hamra, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE
campuses.description: Located in the Academic Zone of Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone (RAKEZ). Uses blended learning combining classroom teaching with online resources. Not in Dubai.
campuses.why_choose: International RAKEZ campus with blended learning and IWEP bootcamp.

campuses.name: The Superior University, Lahore – Okara Campus
campuses.address: Jawad Avenue, Safdar Ghafoor Town, Okara, Punjab
campuses.description: Superior University's Okara Campus extends quality higher education to southern Punjab. Located on Jawad Avenue in Safdar Ghafoor Town, the campus serves local students with undergraduate programs.
campuses.why_choose: Accessibility for students in Okara and surrounding areas; affordable quality education closer to home.

details.minimum_qualification: 16 Years of Education (BS / MSc in Psychology or Applied Psychology) from an HEC recognized institution.
details.minimum_marks: Minimum 2.5 CGPA out of 4.0 or 50% marks under the annual system.
details.required_documents: Matriculation Certificate, Intermediate Transcript, Undergraduate Degree & Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC), CNIC/B-Form, Passport-sized Photographs, and HEC Equivalence (if applicable).
details.merit_criteria: Academic Background (40%) + University Entry Test (40%) + Panel Interview (20%).
details.scholarship_eligibility: Academic excellence waivers are awarded for top academic performance in qualifying exams or highest scores in the institutional entrance evaluation.
details.fee_note: Includes Rs. 20,000 one-time admission dues, Rs. 10,000 security deposit, Rs. 7,500 recurring miscellaneous semester charges, and Rs. 115,000 basic tuition per semester. Program spans exactly 2 semesters across 1 academic year. Costs exclude examination registrations, clinical supervision extensions, or travel costs related to independent hospital placements.
